description: This source file is a shell script for a suite of tests related to the 'git format-patch' command. It sets up various test scenarios, including patch generation, headers, threading, subject line wrapping, signatures, covering letter customization, filename length limits, and integration with version control operations. The script uses testing helpers and expectations to validate correct behavior and output of the 'git format-patch' functionality.

methods.name: check_patch
methods.description: Verify that the patch file content resembles a well-formed email with From, Date, and Subject headers.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Check that the produced patch contains the correct From header with proper quoting and encoding when necessary.

methods.name: signature
methods.description: Generate a signature string for the patch email with optional custom text.

methods.name: append_signoff
methods.description: Append a Signed-off-by footer to a commit, generate a patch, and check for the presence of relevant signed-off lines.
